units.source_text: 我拼劲全力喊了这么几句。

en.t: I shouted those few words with all the strength I had.

units.source_text: 但是丈夫只是嫌恶的看着我。

en.t: But my husband only looked at me with disgust.

units.source_text: 我忍住要炸了的胸膛，寻找丈夫的大刀。

en.t: Holding back the pain in my chest as if it would burst, I searched for my husband's sword.

units.source_text: 可能大刀被强盗拿走了，就连弓箭也找不到了。

en.t: The sword had probably been taken by the bandit, and even the bow and arrows were nowhere to be found.

units.source_text: 幸亏我的小刀还在我的脚下。

en.t: Fortunately, my small knife was still at my feet.

units.source_text: 我举着小刀，对丈夫说：“现在，我需要先杀了你，

en.t: I raised the small knife and said to my husband, "Now I must kill you first,
and then put an end to myself."
